cohort: 43 patients preoperatively diagnosed with major placenta previa and/or placenta accreta who underwent prophylactic aortic catheterization before caesarean section
finding: Intraoperative aortic balloon occlusion is a relatively safe method for treating placenta previa and/or placenta accreta during scheduled and emergency CS and might be helpful to prevent hysterectomy and embolization in women wishing to preserve fertility.
